title: Halifax Shore Excursion: Halifax on Foot
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
At time of booking, Cruise ship passengers must provide the following information at time of booking: ship name, docking time, disembarkation time and re-boarding time
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: A great way to explore Halifax is by foot. The area is steeped in history and it is one of the most popular ports to enjoy a shore excursion.
